description: Fontaines à boire sur l'ensemble de la métropole issues d'OpenStreetMap is a dataset listed in DATA Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by OSM. Liste des points d'eau potable sur le territoire de la métropole Aix-Marseille-Provence présents dans OpenStreetMap. Requête détaillée OSM: (amenity=drinkingwater OR amenity=waterpoint OR drinkingwater=treated OR drinkingwater=yes OR waterway=waterpoint) and natural!=spring and fee!=yes in Aix-Marseille-Provence Voir document en pièce jointe pour la requête complète. Coverage: Aix-Marseille-Provence Metropolis. The portal files it under Environnement, Service. The portal shows 513 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-04-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODBL. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ampmetropole-fr-portal.
